description: BCD securely connects ChatGPT and Codex to computers you explicitly authorize. Inspect and edit files, run shell commands, and manage durable processes across paired devices. New computers start read-only, with write and process access enabled only when you approve it.

defaultPrompt: Show me the computers connected to BCD and summarize which ones are available.
Create a text file named notes.txt in my BCD workspace with a short checklist, then read it back to verify it.
Start a short background process that prints a message after two seconds, then show me its output.
